text: Which testis-specific genes are specific to Sertoli or Leydig cells in the single-cell data and have no detectable mRNA in ovary?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Testis / Tissue enriched AND Cell type category (scRNA): Leydig cells, Sertoli cells / Cell type enriched AND Tissue category (RNA): Ovary / Not detected
understanding: The user is looking for genes that are testis-specific at the tissue RNA level, specific to Sertoli or Leydig cells in the single-cell RNA-seq dataset, and have no detectable mRNA expression in the ovary.

trail.why: The requirement asks for testis-specific genes, which corresponds to selecting 'testis' with the specificity category 'Tissue enriched' (at least four-fold higher mRNA level compared to any other tissue).

trail.why: Being specific to a single cell type corresponds to 'Cell type enriched', applied to Leydig cells or Sertoli cells.
